joinHint: Copy a room URL, then select Join. Or use --server URL --room NAME.
connectionFailed: Connection failed. Check the server and room, then join again.
invalidRoom: Use an http(s) room URL ending in /room/NAME (localhost is supported).
protocolRequired: This room requires timeline playback protocol v1. Legacy playback is unsupported.
invalidTimeline: Playback data could not be validated. Join again to recover.
unsupportedTimeline: This desktop preview requires the server’s immediate timeline snapshots.
unsupportedSource: This source is unsupported. This preview plays YouTube only; no browser is running.
empty: The room has no current track. No browser is running.
browserFailed: Could not start YouTube. Check that Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is installed.
bridgeFailed: The player bridge is unavailable. Disconnect and join again.
commandUnavailable: Playback controls are waiting for a fresh snapshot and clock.
commandRejected: The room rejected this playback command.
autoplay-blocked: YouTube needs a click inside the video to allow playback, then select Play.
unsupported-rate: YouTube does not support this playback speed.
error: YouTube playback failed. Disconnect and join to retry.
providerTimeout: YouTube did not become ready in time.
help: Undertone desktop: --server http://localhost:3000 --room NAME [--muted]. Or paste a full /room/NAME URL using the native Join button. --smoke-test starts offline, muted, and exits automatically.
